mapper.insert: INSERT INTO opc_community_rating (module_id, user_id, score, review, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{moduleId}, #{userId}, #{score}, #{review}, NOW(), NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE score = VALUES(score), review = VALUES(review), update_time = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT id, module_id, user_id, score, review, create_time, update_time FROM opc_community_rating WHERE module_id = #{moduleId} ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT IFNULL(AVG(score), 0) FROM opc_community_rating WHERE module_id = #{moduleId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM opc_community_rating WHERE module_id = #{moduleId}
